label: The sk-code-opencode surface is anchored by the packet folder .skilled/skills/sk-code/sk-code-opencode/ (~99 path lines for **/*code-opencode*; assets/checklists 14 files, assets/scripts 8 files, benchmark/reports 15 files, changelog 13+ shown) and the runtime mirror .hermes/skills/sk-code-opencode/SKILL.md; a bare-form history dir .skilled/changelog/sk-code/code-opencode exists.

The hub-root routing JSONs carry the surface key: mode-registry.json L5/L19/L79/L88/L89 (surfaces list + workflowMode/packet/packetSkillName), hub-router.json L7/L36/L39 (tieBreak + surfaceBundle resources), graph-metadata.json L230/L250-L253/L278/L282 (resource paths + causal summary), leaf-manifest.json L114-L115 (typed leaf pair), description.json L47 (advisor descriptor).

Cross-packet references are path-bearing, not prose: sk-code-quality/SKILL.md L69/L107-L112/L122-L127 load ../sk-code-opencode/assets/checklists/* (34 matches in file), sk-code-quality/scripts/typo-flags.test.sh L17 pins the packet's verify-router-sync.cjs, and sk-code-review/SKILL.md L39/L42/L499, sk-code-review/references/review-core.md L68, sk-code-webflow/README.md L94 name the surface.

Rename-blocking guard/integration code holds the literal: doctor sk-code-setup-check.cjs L59 + tests L29/L208 (drift-guard path literal), parent-skill-check.cjs L1159/L1163 (SK_CODE_NATIVE_SURFACE, check 5l) + invariants test L489-L514, bin tests compiled-route-surface-hint.test.cjs L65/L72/L89/L112, packet assets/scripts verify-router-sync.cjs L33/L261-L265, router-replay-lib.cjs L495/L611/L628, verify-doc-claims.cjs L68, and scripts/tests verify-router-sync.test.cjs L35/L102-L161 + verify-doc-claims.test.cjs L9.

Counts: orchestrator seed 137 non-spec files naming sk-code-opencode (107 md, 14 json, 10 cjs, 2 txt, 2 jsonl, 1 yaml, 1 sh), 43 non-spec bare-form files, 1196 spec markdown; this iteration measured 15694 identity occurrences repo-wide, 38 .cjs matches (complete), 18 hub-root JSON matches, ~99 path lines for **/*code-opencode*.

Surface packets are advisor-invisible by design (hub SKILL.md L74/L183): the advisor routes the single identity sk-code, so advisor DB/routes are expected to hold hub-level identity only — direct DB inspection carried to Q3.

Exclusion sweep anomaly: cli[ _-]?opencode|.opencode returned 2129598 occurrences — implausible for source references, likely dominated by a vendored/generated tree or non-ignored content; scoped re-run required (Q2).

History precedent: a prior family rename is recorded (sk-code-quality/changelog/v1.1.1.0.md L25) and benchmark transcripts embed past route outputs (benchmark/reports/compiled-routing/2026-07-21--real--luna-high/skill-benchmark-report.json L29); rewrite-vs-exclude decision is Q5.

The surface key must move atomically across mode-registry.json, hub-router.json, graph-metadata.json, leaf-manifest.json, description.json and the packet folder path: verify-router-sync.cjs cross-checks leaf-manifest against the on-disk packet folder (L261-265) and doctor check 5l pins SK_CODE_NATIVE_SURFACE (parent-skill-check.cjs L1163).
